nodes.name: .npmrc
nodes.summary: npm client configuration holding an authentication entry for the public npm registry, used when publishing the react-socket-link package. Contains a credential and should not be committed or shared.
nodes.languageNotes: A registry-scoped auth token line in .npmrc lets `npm publish` authenticate without an interactive login; such files are normally gitignored or use an environment-variable reference instead of a literal token.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config that lints all TypeScript/TSX sources with the recommended JS, typescript-eslint, React Hooks and React Refresh (Vite) rule sets using browser globals, ignoring the dist output.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the ESLint 9 flat config API (`defineConfig` and `globalIgnores` from `eslint/config`) instead of the legacy .eslintrc format.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite library-mode build and Vitest configuration: builds two entry points (main `index` and React-free `core`) as ES and CJS bundles with React externalized, emits type declarations via vite-plugin-dts from tsconfig.build.json, and runs tests in jsdom.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-entry `build.lib.entry` plus a custom `fileName` produces `index.js/index.cjs` and `core.js/core.cjs`, supporting a subpath export for the standalone core.
